description: Return today's aggregate activity across all of The Living Bread, as counts only and never names: people prayed for, encouraged, offered a talk, offered help and met in person; what members are carrying today by feeling, with how many were prayed over; worldwide Prayer in Place totals; and, on the signed-in /me endpoint only, Table counts (tables is null on the public endpoint). Use for "what is the family doing today" or "what are people carrying". For believer counts by city use kingdom_map; for individual stories use testimonies; for prayers at one place use prayers_left_near. Read live at call time; "today" is the database's current day. Access: no sign-in; shared limit of 300 requests a minute per IP.
name: body_today

attribution.description: Credit line for the data: The Living Bread (living-bread.org).

carrying.description: Today's feelings named by members: feeling, people carrying it, and how many of them were prayed over. Empty when none named yet.

content_layers.description: Which fields are Scripture and which are human interpretation or reflection.

door.description: Link to The Living Bread home.

evidence.description: Present when Scripture was read: translation, canon, corpus version, attribution, and a SHA-256 per passage.

freshness.description: How current the answer is: kind (scheduled | recently_observed | verified_live | record), retrieved_at, available_now (true only when activity was verified live).

ids.description: Up to 25 ids found in this answer, for follow-up calls.

license.description: License URL of the returned data (CC BY 4.0 unless stated).

next_actions.description: Up to 4 links the person can open next.

ok.description: Always true on a successful answer (errors come back as isError, never here).

places.description: Worldwide Prayer in Place totals: prayers, places, places prayed at today, approximate countries.

responding.description: Today's counts of people prayed for, encouraged, offered a talk, offered help, and met in person; null if unreadable.

result_state.description: "empty" when nothing matched (count 0, no results); the text then says so plainly.

source_url.description: The first public web page this answer came from or points to.

tables.description: Signed-in only: people gathered at Tables today, Tables set, and people at a Table now. Null on the public endpoint.

visibility.description: "public" for shared data, "yours" for the signed-in believer's own data.

title: The Body today
